moral.zh: 别人的喜欢，可以参考；自己的需要，也值得认真听。
moral.en: Other people can inspire us, but our own needs deserve a careful listen too.

Reference images are for character identities and rendering style ONLY; do not copy their props or scene.
THIS PAGE'S SCENE (follow literally): Wide sunset city sidewalk: An'an and Mom hand in hand, blue paper star bracelet visible, peaceful hopeful ending.
ONLY the people explicitly required by this scene may appear. Character identities: An'an is a six-year-old Chinese GIRL, round face, ear-length straight black bob, yellow star clip on her left, teal hoodie, blue jeans, white sneakers with red trim. Mom has shoulder-length black hair, coral cardigan, cream trousers.
Scene actions, object states and number of people must match exactly. No extra people. No text, captions, letters, numbers, speech bubbles, logos, watermark, anthropomorphic animals, animal protagonists, distorted hands or duplicate characters. Children's drawings contain pictures only. Paper boats, teddy bears and toy cars are objects, not living characters.
An'an wears a BLUE PAPER BRACELET with one hand-drawn star, NOT a wristwatch. Never put a clock face on her paper bracelet.

parentGuide.goal: 帮助孩子辨认喜欢、需要和想融入朋友的感受。
parentGuide.reminder: 不把想买东西说成虚荣，也不以买或不买奖励孩子；允许孩子保留愿望。
questions: 安安想要手表时，心里有哪些不同的想法？
你有没有喜欢过别人拥有的东西？喜欢它的什么？
parentGuide.activity: 挑一件想要的物品，分别画出它吸引你的地方和你会怎样使用它，过几天再聊聊。

ageTips.age4to5: 先看表情和动作，允许孩子用指画面、点头或简单词语表达感受。
ageTips.age6to8: 讨论不同角色的想法和可选择的办法，不把一种选择当成唯一正确答案。
